verified: BMW has opened the Woodruff, South Carolina, battery assembly plant and begun series production of high-voltage packs for the iX5, according to the report.
unconfirmed: production volume, battery-cell sourcing, the iX5's launch date and price, and independent confirmation of the production start.

verified: 据源报道，宝马已正式启用南卡罗来纳州伍德拉夫的电池组装厂并启动批量生产，该厂为 iX5 组装高压电池。
unconfirmed: 电池包的具体容量、化学体系、电芯供应商和工厂年产能均未公布；iX5 的上市日期、售价、美国交付安排，以及该厂是否已达到目标量产节拍，也没有独立数据或官方细节。

titles.en: BMW opens U.S. battery plant, starts packs for new iX5
titles.zh: 宝马美国电池组装厂投产，iX5 率先采用本土电池包
